fact: The Malawi Revenue Authority's representative said the authority is developing its second Integrated Tax Administration System, ITAS II, in-house and is still seeking funding for it.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that e-filing is in use for tax and/or customs declarations in Malawi, linking the MRA's Msonkho Online portal; no earlier date is given, so the round's year stands for the year's end.
